comparison.objective: Calibrate a biased angle gauge against a reference and level a platform.
comparison.physical_skill: Place/read a gauge and operate adjustment buttons using closed-loop measurement.
comparison.success_condition: Reference and platform readings completed; true platform tilt within 0.15°, hands clear for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Instrument calibration and levelling do not test impact fracture, mandrel stabilization, retained-insert protection, or fragment recovery.
